review_requirements: Confirm the exact title, NCT03588572, institution and August 2018 identity/date match between protocol and SAP.
Confirm allocation ratio, concealment and assessor masking.
Adjudicate the definitive WAB AQ primary model, baseline adjustment, covariance and V3 contrast.
Review imaging preprocessing, thresholds, ROI/seed definitions and the boundary between confirmatory and exploratory analyses.
Complete efficacy and imaging populations, estimand, missing-data, multiplicity, effect-reporting and safety specifications.
Verify every critical locator against the rendered one-based physical PDF pages.
